description: Shared Renovate preset for all Sagargupta16 repos. Extend via: extends: ['github>Sagargupta16/shared-workflows'].

Cadence: one grouped minor/patch PR plus one grouped major PR per repo on the 1st of each month, auto-merged when CI is green. prConcurrentLimit 1 serialises them so they never pile up. Security fixes ignore the schedule and all limits by design.

separateMajorMinor is deliberately left at its default (true). It takes priority over packageRule groups, which is why majors get their own PR. Do NOT set it to false: one blocked major (eslint 10, typescript 7 in Sept 2026) would then hold every minor and patch hostage for the whole month.
lockFileMaintenance is off (Renovate default). It was a third monthly PR stream and the grouped update already refreshes in-range lock entries.
schedule: on the 1st day of the month
on the 1st day of the month
